question: Each cycle of β-oxidation of fatty acids follows the following sequence of reactions:

options.opa: NAD + -dependent oxidation; FAD-dependent oxidation; hydration; thiolysis.
options.opb: FAD-dependent oxidation; NAD + -dependent oxidation; hydration; thiolysis.
options.opc: FAD-dependent oxidation; hydration; NAD + -dependent oxidation; thiolysis.
options.opd: Thiolysis; FAD-dependent oxidation; hydration; NAD + -dependent oxidation.

analysis: The correct sequence of reactions in each cycle of β-oxidation of fatty acids is FAD-dependent oxidation; NAD+-dependent oxidation; hydration; thiolysis.
